name: Terrarium 65x40x40
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 65x40x40 cm. Volume: 104.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 65x40x40 cm terrarium has a floor of 2600 cm² and 104 liters. The 40x40 cm cross-section gives it enough height for a branch and a lamp at a distance, and the 65 cm length fits on a dresser 70 cm wide. It has no 3D background, and cover comes from the outer film on three sides.

A growing ball python uses the 40 cm depth for a larger hide and a low branch. For young tortoises and a skink, the width lets them go around the decor instead of climbing over it. Over 65 cm of length, the difference between the warm and cool side is achieved with one lamp at the end. For a bearded dragon this is a size only while it is a juvenile.

The narrower model of the same length is the 65x35x35, and the longer one with the same cross-section is the 100x40x40. The outer film is chosen from 34 patterns. We build changed dimensions in 7 to 14 days and ship by courier. This model has no background, but we add 3D relief if you order it.
